results.title: In Photos | Gyanesh Kumar Resignation Protests Spread From Delhi To Hyderabad, Srinagar
results.description: Demonstrators took to the streets in New Delhi, Hyderabad and Srinagar on Saturday, October 17, over demands including the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. In New Delhi, Justice Morcha members, students and youth activists marched from the Press Club of India to Jantar Mantar under the banner ‘Reclaim Jantar Mantar’, while police detained demonstrators. Student activists were also detained during a protest in Hyderabad. In Srinagar, Congress workers protested against the election chief and an administrative officer accused of abusing a female colleague. Women in Delhi separately marched against alleged police brutality against women protesters.

results.title: Aamir Khan’s Niece Zayn Marie Shows Injury Marks After Mumbai Police Detention
results.description: A video shared by Zayn Marie Khan has brought fresh attention to the police action during a protest in Mumbai. The actor, who is Aamir Khan’s niece, posted footage showing injury marks on her arms, fingers and legs after being detained during a demonstration on October 10. In the Instagram reel shared on October 11, Zayn delivered a pointed message about fear and intimidation. Her post came a day after she was detained alongside her cousin, actor Imran Khan, and actor Lekha Washington at Mumbai’s August Kranti Maidan. The trio were released a few hours later. Zayn Marie Khan Shows Injury Marks After Police Detention Zayn shared a video in which she showed marks on different parts of her body, including her arms, fingers and legs. Alongside the footage, she made a statement that quickly attracted attention. “Do not scare us so much that no fear is left in the first place,” she said. Her caption read, “she exposes (the state) on the internet.” The post followed a series of Instagram Stories documenting her detention. Zayn had earlier shared footage showing herself with Imran Khan and Lekha Washington inside a police van. While the images showed marks on her body, the circumstances in which those marks occurred have not been independently established by the material cited in the reports. Her post has nevertheless raised questions online about the experience of protesters during the police action. Why Were Zayn Marie, Imran Khan and Lekha Washington Detained? The incident took place at August Kranti Maidan in Mumbai during a demonstration held in support of the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP)'s protest campaign. The protest was linked to demands for the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. Protesters raised concerns about voter-list changes and the alleged exclusion of eligible voters. Mumbai Police detained hundreds of people during the action, including Imran Khan and Zayn Marie. Authorities said the gathering was not permitted at August Kranti Maidan, citing restrictions on protest locations under Bombay High Court directions. CJP supporters, however, maintained that they had emailed the police seeking permission but had not received a response. The dispute over permission became a central part of the controversy surrounding the demonstration. What Did Zayn Marie Say About Her Detention? Zayn also shared videos describing what happened after she and the other actors were taken into custody. In one Instagram Story, she questioned why they had been detained and said officials had not provided a clear explanation. She also described delays while they were at the police station. Imran Khan, meanwhile, shared his own account of the incident. In a video, he said he did not know why the group had been picked up and claimed they had been driven around in a police van for approximately two hours before being dropped at an undisclosed location. The actors were released a few hours after their detention and later posted updates on social media. Lekha Washington also shared videos confirming that they were safe. In another post, she alleged that they faced difficulties finding transport home after their release because drivers were being discouraged from taking them. That allegation has not been independently established in the reports cited here. Imran Khan’s Jaane Tu... Ya Jaane Na Reference Goes Viral Amid the tense circumstances, Zayn shared a lighter moment involving Imran inside the police van. The video referred to Imran's 2008 debut film, Jaane Tu... Ya Jaane Na, in which he played Jai Rathore. In the film, his character faces conditions involving riding a horse, going to jail and getting into a fight to prove himself a true “Ranjore ka Rathore.” Zayn asked Imran whether he had ever ridden a horse, gone to jail or beaten someone up. Imran replied that he had ridden a horse but had never physically assaulted anyone. He also joked about whether the detention might count towards the jail requirement, responding, “Ho sakta hai” (It's possible). The exchange offered a brief moment of humour during an otherwise serious episode. Imran also posted a photograph from inside the police van with the caption, “Apparently I'm going for a drive.” What Is the Controversy Behind the CJP Protest? The demonstration was part of a wider campaign seeking accountability over the revision of electoral rolls and demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The Special Intensive Revision, or SIR, has become a contentious issue, with critics alleging that the process could exclude eligible voters. The Election Commission has disputed allegations of political bias, while supporters of the protest have called for greater transparency and accountability. The controversy has also extended beyond Mumbai. CJP supporters and other demonstrators have organised protests in Delhi, where police action against participants and the detention of movement leaders have drawn further attention. The question of whether protesters had permission to assemble, the reasons for their detention and the allegations surrounding their treatment remain important parts of the debate. Why Zayn Marie Khan’s Video Matters Zayn’s post has brought a personal account of the protest into the public conversation. Her decision to show the marks on her body and speak about fear has added another dimension to the discussion about how demonstrations are handled. At the same time, it is important to distinguish between what is visible in the video, what Zayn has alleged and what has been independently verified. The footage shows the marks she presented, but it does not by itself establish how they occurred or who was responsible. The wider issue goes beyond a celebrity family. Protests involving voting rights, electoral transparency and police restrictions raise questions that deserve clear answers from the authorities and the people making allegations. For now, Zayn Marie Khan’s message has ensured that the Mumbai detention remains part of that conversation. Disclaimer: This article is based on media reports and publicly shared social media posts. Allegations about police conduct have not been independently verified.
